job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
General Mills is hiring a Senior Accountant for our corporate accounting team in Minneapolis.

Responsibilities:
- Lead parts of the monthly, quarterly and annual close
- Prepare and review account reconciliations and journal entries
- Perform variance analysis and explain results to finance partners
- Support internal controls and SOX compliance testing
- Coordinate with external auditors
- Identify process improvements and automation opportunities

Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Accounting
- 4+ years of accounting experience, public accounting or large company preferred
- CPA or working toward CPA preferred
- Strong Excel skills; SAP experience a plus
- Knowledge of US GAAP

professionalSummary.summary: Staff accountant with 4 years of month-end close, reconciliations and audit support at a mid-size manufacturer.

achievements: Owned 40 balance sheet reconciliations each month-end close
Cut the monthly close from 9 to 6 business days by building reconciliation templates in Excel
Prepared journal entries for accruals, prepaids and fixed assets in NetSuite
Supported the annual external audit, preparing 60+ PBC schedules
Prepared monthly sales tax filings for 12 states
Processed 300+ vendor invoices a month and ran weekly check runs
